info.name: PizzaHub - Public Menu API tests
info.description: See docs/MENU_API_TESTING.md. Needs some APPROVED menu items in the database (see 'Test data' there). No login is required for any request. Run top to bottom: request 1 stores an item id used by request 10.

exec: pm.test("200 and success=true", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().success).to.eql(true); });

pm.test("data is an array + pagination block exists", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.data).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(b.pagination).to.have.all.keys("page","limit","totalItems","totalPages","hasNextPage","hasPreviousPage"); });
pm.test("no vendorId / status in any item", () => { pm.response.json().data.forEach(i => { pm.expect(i).to.not.have.property("vendorId"); pm.expect(i).to.not.have.property("status"); }); });

pm.test("saves the first item id for request 10", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.length, "need at least one approved item in the DB").to.be.above(0); pm.collectionVariables.set("itemId", d[0]._id); });
